canonical_json.object_member_order: ascending Unicode scalar sequence of NFC member names
canonical_json.numbers: base-10 shortest integers only; schemas forbid floating JSON numbers in digest inputs
canonical_json.strings: Unicode NFC; escape only quotation mark, reverse solidus, and U+0000 through U+001F
canonical_json.unknown_fields: reject according to the owning schema
canonical_json.pointer_extension: In excluded_json_pointers, * matches every element of exactly one array level. No other wildcard exists.

semantic.reason: Paired syntaxes and source locations must not change semantic identity.

construction_rules: Validate the complete input against its owning schema.
Remove only the excluded pointer selections declared for the selected domain, expanding * exactly as specified above.
Serialize the remaining value with the canonical_json rules.
Hash the UTF-8 tag, its declared terminator byte, and then the canonical UTF-8 bytes.
Encode the 32-byte digest as lowercase hexadecimal.
